title: Render a text table
hints: Do it in phases: validate, turn every cell into its text, compute one width per column, then build the lines.
widths[i] = max(len(headers[i]), max(len(row[i]) for row in text_rows)); zip(*rows) transposes a list of rows into columns if you prefer.
A format spec can take its width from a variable: f"{text:<{w}}" left-aligns, f"{text:>{w}}" right-aligns. Decide the alignment from the original value, not its text.
isinstance(True, int) is True, so check `not isinstance(v, bool)` before treating an int as a number. Finish with '\n'.join(line.rstrip() for line in lines).
